name: Kagamigawa Chloe
source:
(19 in Memories Off 6: Next Relation)
Hobbies: Horse riding, archery.
Likes: Sewing.
Hates: Carrots, green pepper... She's picky when it comes to food.

A third year student at Sumisora High School and the student council president. Her father is Japanese and her mother is French. This makes her the second heroine with mixed blood in the Memories Off series (First one being [url=/c7880]Shion Futami[/url] from the first game). 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Memories_Off_6:_T-wave]Wikipedia[/url].]
